description: Records the person's answer to one question: the choice (mine, about_me, not_me, or skip), and for a wrong statement the right fact in their words. Applied at once: a result marked not_me leaves every count. Returns the updated counts and score and the next question. Use this when the person has answered. Do not use for answers the person did not give. Side effects: changes the account's own Reputation Agent record.

choice.description: One of the question's choice ids, or skip. Example: "not_me"

correction.description: For a wrong statement: the right fact, in the person's words. Example: "I joined Northwind in 2021, not 2019."

question_id.description: The question id from get_questions. Example: "5f0c2a9e-7b1d-4c3e-9a8f-2d6b4e1c7a90"

name: answer_question
title: Answer a question
